2. Learned Counsel for the Appellant seeks and is granted permission to withdraw the present Application with liberty to file appropriate Application in accordance with law seeking condonation of delay.

6.1 The challenge in the present Appeal is for enhancement of the amount of compensation awarded in the sum of Rs.8,81,000/- along with interest.
It is the case of the Appellant that the accident happened on 05.10.2016 while the claim petition was filed on 22.02.2017.
8. Issue Notice.

9. The Registry is directed to place on record the digital copy of the Trial Court Record duly paginated and book-marked in accordance with the rules of the High Court.
